agent.finish_summary: Fixed inverted condition in IdentifierList.get_identifiers() in sqlparse/sql.py (sqlparse/sql.py line ~491): changed 'if (token.is_whitespace or token.match(T.Punctuation, ','))' to 'if not (...)' so it correctly yields only identifier tokens, not whitespace/commas, matching its docstring. This was the root cause of the 24 'format reindent aligned' regressions since AlignedIndentFilter._process_identifierlist (and reindent.py's identifier-list handling) rely on get_identifiers() to return actual identifiers. Verified with manual sqlparse.format() calls using reindent_aligned=True and reindent=True on SELECT lists, CASE statements, and ORDER BY lists — all now produce correct alignment/indentation.
